'''R2-A6''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid]]<ref name="WCF" /> of the [[R-series]] produced by [[Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="IncrediBuilds" />

==Biography==
[[File:Repair_droid_TCG_by_Adam_lane.jpg|thumb|left|200px|R2-A6 at work making repairs.]]
During the [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation]], it served as the personal [[Astromech droid|astromech unit]] of [[Ric Olié]], who considered his astromech a good luck charm.<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Ric Olié - Naboo Pilot}}</ref> Olié was a [[pilot]] who served in the [[Bravo Squadron]] group of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]], a wing of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]] whose job it was to protect the [[Monarch of Naboo]]. While he left Naboo to accompany [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] to the [[The galaxy|galactic]] [[capital]] [[Coruscant]], R2-A6 remained behind in the [[Theed Royal Palace]]'s [[Theed Hangar|hangar]] docked into an [[N-1 starfighter]]. When Olié returned as part of an effort to [[Battle of Naboo|liberate]] Naboo, he boarded the [[starfighter]] carrying R2-A6 and launched out of the palace, joining his [[squad]]mates in attacking the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship]] ''[[Vuutun Palaa]]''. The [[battleship]] was eventually destroyed by the young pilot [[Anakin Skywalker]], and the Trade Federation was successfully driven off Naboo.<ref name="TPM" />

R2-A6 was still active following the [[Battle of Endor]] and joined the [[Uprising|crew]] of a young [[The Smuggler|smuggler]] within the [[Anoat sector]] following the [[Iron Blockade|blockading]] of the [[sector]] by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWU" />

R2-A6 was a fearless and bold [[droid]], and was capable of operating many systems including defense grids, [[starship]] systems or communication systems.<ref name="SWU" /> It had [[Color|green]] and white paneling.<ref name="TPM" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Howdy! If you like your lungs… and your life… I wouldn't breath that gas in. Usually fixing this stuff is right up my street, but I'm in between software updates, so I'm no use.|translated=1|R2-A6's dialogue in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga''|<ref name="SkywalkerSaga">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref>}}
R2-A6 first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which was released in [[1999]] and did not name the [[droid]].<ref name="TPM" /> It was first identified in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] on the ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' card [https://starwarscardtrader.fandom.com/wiki/Ric_Oli%C3%A9_-_Naboo_Pilot Ric Olié - Naboo Pilot], released in [[2015]].<ref name="SWCT" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] in 1999 with the character's action figure in the [[Hasbro]] [[Star Wars: Episode I (toy line)|''Star Wars: Episode I'']] toy line.<ref name="Toy">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Episode I (toy line)|packtype=12" Figure|pack=R2-A6|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/episodeI12-r2a6.asp}}</ref>

In the [[2022]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', R2-A6 can be found outside the [[podracer]] hangar of the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena|Grand Arena]] in [[Mos Espa]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. The droid warns the player in [[binary]] about [[poison]]ous [[gas]] leaking from a pair of damaged podracer [[engine]]s laying nearby, stating that usually it would repair them itself, but it is unable as it is currently between software updates. The player may then fix the engines themselves as part of the "Podracer Prize" mission.<ref name="SkywalkerSaga" />
